chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ, from his paternal uncle Yaʿqūb ibn Sālim al-Aḥmar, from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

He was asked about a menstruating woman: what is lawful for her husband from her? He said: “She should wrap herself with a waist-wrapper down to the knees and uncover her leg, and he may have what is above the waist-wrapper.”

key_terms.بِإِزَارٍ: with an izar, a lower-body covering
key_terms.تَتَّزِرُ: she wraps herself with a waist-wrapper

ai.seo_question: What is permissible for a husband with his wife during menstruation according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning what is permissible between a husband and his menstruating wife. It specifies a boundary using an izar, indicating what is allowed above that covering.
